newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS EASES LOWER AS BIDDERS BACK OFF.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS EASES LOWER AS BIDDERS BACK OFF.

text.p: The IPE natural gas market slipped lower on Friday as bids slumped to well below Thursday's settlement levels.
Just 25 lots had traded at 1145 GMT. All trades were done on October, which shed 0.020 to trade at 10.930 pence a therm.
New trading times came into force on Friday, and the contract continued to trade after midday without a break. Business will close an hour later at 1700 London time.
On the board for the first time was the new current month, or balance of month contract. August was untraded in the morning but the bid/offer range moved closer to 9.0/9.3 pence.
Bids on winter months fell heavily, but offers failed to respond.
The second quarter next year looked tigher, with April talked at 11.90/12.20 pence and May at 10.80/11.20 pence.
